note: app.sqlite, snapshotted via better-sqlite3's real SQLite online-backup API (apps/daemon/src/backup/create.ts).
RUNTIME_DATA_DIR/projects, recursively copied with a per-file sha256 checksum index.
RUNTIME_DATA_DIR/library, recursively copied with a per-file sha256 checksum index.
RUNTIME_DATA_DIR/memory (per-fact markdown, the index, and .config.json), recursively copied with a per-file sha256 checksum index.

RUNTIME_DATA_DIR/app-config.json IS archived, but with agentCliEnv and agentCliEnvIntent (the on-disk BYOK provider-key material) stripped before writing -- see the byok-keys row below. Every other preference (onboarding state, agent/skill/design-system selection, telemetry choices, custom instructions, project locations) is preserved.

mcp-config.json (server list), mcp-oauth-clients.json (cached OAuth client registrations), and mcp-tokens.json (stored OAuth/PAT tokens per MCP server) are never written to the archive in any form. Documented gap: a restored install has no MCP servers configured; the user must re-add and reauthenticate each MCP server after restore.

connectors/credentials.json, connectors/composio-config.json, and the Composio catalog cache are never written to the archive in any form. Documented gap: a restored install has no connector (GitHub, etc.) authorized; the user must reauthenticate each connector after restore.

agentCliEnv / agentCliEnvIntent -- the local-CLI-override provider API keys (e.g. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) embedded in app-config.json -- are stripped from the archived copy of app-config.json before it is written and never appear anywhere else in the archive. Documented gap: a restored install has no local BYOK provider keys configured; the user must re-enter them after restore.
